# State Nationalist Reform

> Public educational information about trusts, trust funding and administration, the organization's mission, and the claims represented in its standing diagram. State Nationalist Reform is not a law firm and does not provide legal advice.

## Pages

- [Home](https://statenationalistreform.com/): Overview of State Nationalist Reform, its featured video, and links to the mission, funding, standing and resources pages.
- [Mission](https://statenationalistreform.com/mission.html): The organization's stated trust stewardship mission, principles, and initiatives.
- [Funding and Trust](https://statenationalistreform.com/funding-trust.html): Trust funding information and an asset-distribution illustration; educational content, not legal or tax advice.
- [Standing](https://statenationalistreform.com/standing.html): An interactive explanation of the site's asset-flow diagram, including the Federal Reserve System, state courts, the claimed “Public Nexus,” and the National Reform Protocol's stated objective. The diagram's relationships are claims, not established legal outcomes.
- [Resources](https://statenationalistreform.com/vault.html): Descriptions of trust-administration resources.

## Important context

- Statements about trust structures and keeping government or creditors from reaching assets describe the site's proposed framework or intended goals; they are not guarantees of legal protection.
- The Standing page distinguishes the diagram's claims from what the page establishes. Consult a qualified attorney about your circumstances.
